name: TTEC (Partner)
desc:
P&C or Personal Lines Licensed Agent | $20.50/hr + Performance Bonus | Talk to Career Coach, Requires Active P&C License and we may be able to assist in paying for it. 
Company: TTEC
Industry: Insurance | Property & Casualty Customer Service
What Your Day Will Look Like:
This role is specifically set up as a WorkReady Oklahoma referral track with TTEC, meaning this posting exists because of our partnership, worth highlighting that directly to participants. You'll be handling escalated or complex customer calls related to property and casualty insurance, answering questions, resolving issues, and occasionally upselling additional products or services.
You're the person who turns a frustrating insurance question into a resolved, positive experience, researching answers, explaining coverage clearly, and protecting member privacy the way you'd want your own information handled. This is a genuinely more advanced role than TTEC's general healthcare insurance agent posting, since it deals with escalated and complex calls specifically, not just standard inquiries.
Training is instructor-led with camera-on expectations, similar to TTEC's other licensed agent roles, and you'll report to a Team Lead within a structured coaching and development framework.
assessment:
Yes 
Details - 
Situational Judgement Test: Determine the best and worst response to the situation
Personality Questions: Standard personality questions
Customer Proficiency Test: Asks questions
regarding computer literacy. Ex: How do you properly shut down the computer?
How do you rename a file
Internet Speed Test: Completed during the assessment.
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
Education Minimum: Not specified in posting.
 Required Experience: Active Property and Casualty insurance license (hard requirement). 6+ months of customer service experience.
 Preferred Experience: Not separately broken out.
 Required Skills:
Ability to explain product/service knowledge clearly while maintaining privacy standards
Comfort with computers and navigating multiple systems
High speed internet (25+ Mbps)
USB wired headset recommended (Bluetooth headsets not supported)
Smartphone or tablet (iOS or Android) for daily login
Best Fit
This role is ideal for:
A participant who already holds an active Property & Casualty insurance license and wants a fully remote role with a strong hourly base
Someone with genuine customer service experience who's comfortable handling escalated, more complex calls specifically
Anyone who wants continuing education paid for by TTEC and real career development support
People located in one of TTEC's 36 preferred residency states (Oklahoma is included)
Not a Good Fit for:
Anyone without an active P&C license already in hand, this posting does not offer a path to licensure first
Residents of AK, CA, HI, or MT, TTEC is not currently hiring from these states at all
Someone uncomfortable with camera-on training expectations

Escalated call resolution
Customer service
Insurance product knowledge
Privacy compliance
Upselling
Remote customer care
Complex issue resolution
Insurance licensing
Customer experience
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
This position has an automatic offer, no interviewing, after obtaining your Oklahoma state P&C License. 
Apply using the special WRO link and complete the basic assessment. 
You WILL receive an automated phone call about not being eligible, ignore it. It's a ttec issue and is not appliable to WRO. 
Participants should get with their Career Coach and sign up for the Xcel Solutions P&C Producer study account
Take the Oklahoma state exam
Upon passing the exam, let your career coach know ASAP
Your name is submitted to TTEC and an offer is extended
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
Pay: $20.50/hr base pay, plus performance bonus opportunities.
Shift: Full-time, 100% remote.
Benefits: PTO, tuition reimbursement, health and wellness incentives (based on position), continuing education paid for by TTEC.
Equipment Provided: Not explicitly stated, though high speed internet (25+ Mbps) and a smartphone/tablet are required from the employee. USB wired headset recommended.
Felony Friendly?: Case-by-case, based on outside research on TTEC generally. Convictions involving theft or violence appear to be harder disqualifiers, other felony types may be reviewed depending on how long ago they occurred. Beyond TTEC's own policy, the required P&C license itself carries separate state and federal restrictions (18 U.S.C. §§1033-1034 bars anyone convicted of a felony involving fraud, dishonesty, or breach of trust from working in insurance without specific written consent from a state regulator). This needs to be confirmed on the licensing side independent of TTEC's hiring decision.
Drug Test: Yes, based on outside research, TTEC's hiring process includes a background check and drug screening.
Notes: This posting is specifically designated as a WorkReady Oklahoma referral track (requisition 04BVU), meaning it exists as part of our direct partnership with TTEC, worth mentioning this directly when referring participants since it may carry weight in how the application is reviewed. Only refer participants who already hold an active P&C license, this is not a training-to-license role. Pay here ($20.50/hr) is meaningfully higher than TTEC's general healthcare insurance agent posting ($21/hr guaranteed for healthcare vs this P&C role), reflecting the escalated/complex call focus.
Career Pathway: Licensed P&C Insurance Agent → Senior Licensed Agent → Team Lead → Operations Supervisor → Program Manager
training: M-F training will be different than your schedule
